notes: NEW: Proxy mode for Ollama — if the direct cloud call fails with “Failed to fetch”, pick “Proxy (key on server)” and point it at the included proxy instead. The proxy holds your Ollama key on the server and forwards chats, so the page never touches ollama.com directly and never sees the key. The PC proxy (proxy.py) and Cloudflare Worker version ship in the studylens-ollama-proxy pack.
Tutor and screen chat both use the new mode, and failures now name it (“Ollama Proxy failed …”) so you can tell which path broke.
Nothing else changed: the detector, study packs, and tutor rules are untouched.
